notes.estimated_detection_limit: about 0.5 wt% for a well-crystallized heavy-metal oxide in this pattern
notes.implied_cation_ratio: Cu:W = 0.967:1 (3.4 mol% W excess) from the two modeled phases
phases_tested_and_rejected: CuO (tenorite): phase fraction refines to 0.00 wt%, Rwp worsens 3.78 -> 3.87
Cu2O (cuprite): phase fraction refines to 0.00 wt%
Cu3WO6: strongest lines (320 near 33.2 deg, 210 near 20.5 deg) absent from the data
Cu2WO4: strong low-angle lines near 11.6, 13.4, 18.3 deg absent from the data
CuWO4-II (high-pressure P-1 polymorph): refines to 0.2 wt% with no significant Rwp change (3.7788 -> 3.7731); not distinguishable from the main phase
notes.single_phase_control: CuWO4 alone with the same protocol gives Rwp = 8.58%, GOF = 3.54
notes.weight_fraction_basis: normalized over the two modeled crystalline phases; no internal standard, so any amorphous content is not included
notes.weight_fraction_uncertainty_realistic: WO3 = 2.5 +/- 0.2 wt% (spread over reasonable model variants: WO3 Uiso, Ka2 ratio, polarization, zero/displacement, WO3 microstrain); the quoted esd is the statistical value only
